sentences.l2: 网约车为人们的出行带来了极大的便利，然而其背后潜藏的安全隐患却不容忽视。
sentences.l1: Ride-hailing has brought great convenience to people's travel, yet the safety hazards lurking behind it cannot be ignored.

sentences.l2: 近年来，有关司机故意绕路、言语骚扰乃至侵害乘客的报道屡见不鲜，这类事件往往发生在深夜、偏僻路段或行驶轨迹明显异常的情况下，而乘客与司机彼此陌生，一旦遭遇危险，往往难以判断对方的真实意图，也难以及时求助。
sentences.l1: In recent years, reports about drivers deliberately taking detours, verbally harassing and even assaulting passengers have been common, and such incidents often occur late at night, on remote road sections, or when the driving route is clearly abnormal, while passengers and drivers are strangers to each other, so once danger is encountered, it is often hard to judge the other party's true intentions, and also hard to seek help in time.

sentences.l2: 面对这些风险，乘客理应主动采取防范措施。
sentences.l1: Faced with these risks, passengers should take preventive measures on their own initiative.

sentences.l2: 上车之前，务必核对车牌号与司机信息是否与软件显示的一致；行车途中，可借助平台的行程分享功能，把实时位置和预计到达时间发送给家人或朋友，让他人随时掌握自己的动向。
sentences.l1: Before getting in, be sure to check whether the license plate number and driver information match what the app shows; during the ride, you can use the platform's trip-sharing function to send your real-time location and estimated arrival time to family or friends, so that others can keep track of your whereabouts at any time.

sentences.l2: 与此同时，应尽量选择后排靠右的座位，与司机保持适当距离，避免透露过多个人信息。
sentences.l1: At the same time, you should try to choose the seat in the back row on the right, keep a suitable distance from the driver, and avoid revealing too much personal information.

sentences.l2: 倘若遇到违规收费、故意绕路或其他不当行为，乘客切勿忍气吞声，而应保留录音、截图等证据，及时向平台投诉，情况严重时报警处理。
sentences.l1: If you encounter improper charges, deliberate detours or other inappropriate behavior, passengers must not swallow their anger, but should keep evidence such as recordings and screenshots, promptly file a complaint with the platform, and call the police when the situation is serious.

sentences.l2: 唯有平台、监管部门与乘客三方共同发力，才能真正筑牢出行安全的防线。
sentences.l1: Only when the platform, the regulators and the passengers all make joint efforts can the line of defense for travel safety truly be built up.
